reason: The census wife is Dorothea van Devender. His wives married before 1825 were Geertruida Gesina Labuschagne (1816) and Hilletje Roets (1818), and neither matches her.

His wife is Elsie Maria Jordaan, not Dorothea van Devender. The Cradock (Somerset) head 'La Buscagne, Jan Hendrik' with wife Elsje Maria Jordaan matches his full name, his wife and his district.
